lines.en: label bathhousegen:
scene bathhousegen
I decide to go to the bathhouse to see what Io is up to.
lines.zh: 我决定去澡堂看看 Io 在忙什么。

lines.en: Since it's the middle of the day, there aren't many people around.
lines.zh: 因为是白天，周围没多少人。

lines.en: Because of that, we're able to spend the afternoon uninterrupted, eating snacks from one of the vending machines and talking about life.
lines.zh: 也正因为这样，我们得以不受打扰地度过一个下午，吃着自动贩卖机里的零食，聊着人生。

lines.en: Apparently, Io's pretty much the only employee this place has.
lines.zh: 看来 Io 几乎是这里唯一的员工。

lines.en: She informs me that a few temporary hires show up in the summer when the place gets busier, but she's able to hold things down on her own the rest of the year.
lines.zh: 她说夏天忙的时候会来几个临时工，但一年里其余时间她一个人就能撑住。

lines.en: It's strange that I've yet to see her aunt around, though, considering she owns the place and also apparently lives here.
lines.zh: 不过奇怪的是，我一直没见着她姨妈——毕竟那位既是这里的老板，据说也住在这儿。

lines.en: I'm glad that Io is able to run the bathhouse on her own, but she's still just a [young_girl].
lines.zh: Io 能一个人把澡堂撑起来，我当然高兴，可她毕竟还只是个 [young_girl]。

lines.en: Someone like her shouldn't be burdened by such a responsibility just yet.
lines.zh: 像她这样的人，还不该这么早就背负这样的责任。

lines.en: But, then again, it's not like she's dying to get out and spend time with anyone other than Uta or me.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她也没多想出去跟 Uta 或我以外的人待在一起。

lines.en: So...as long as she's fine with wasting away in a place like this, it's not really any of my business.
lines.zh: 所以……只要她甘愿在这种地方消磨下去，那也真不关我的事。

lines.en: scene black
We wind up eating so many snacks that the two of us slip into food-induced comas and need to be carted off to the hospital and placed on life support.
lines.zh: 我们最后吃了太多零食，双双陷入食物昏迷，被抬上担架送进医院靠生命维持系统续命。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: Io never makes it to the hospital. She dies in the ambulance.
lines.zh: Io 没能撑到医院。她死在救护车里。

lines.en: Just kidding again.
lines.zh: 又是开玩笑的。

lines.en: The food-induced coma thing isn't a joke, though.
lines.zh: 不过食物昏迷那事不是玩笑。

lines.en: It's near impossible for me to tear myself away from the counter and walk out of the bathhouse.
lines.zh: 我几乎没法把自己从柜台前拽起来、走出澡堂。

lines.en: As for Io...
lines.zh: 至于 Io……

lines.en: Not a day goes by where I don't blame myself for her passing.
lines.zh: 我每一天都在为她的死自责。

lines.en: Just kidding a third time.
lines.zh: 第三次开玩笑。

lines.en: $ io_love += 1
{i}Io's affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
